author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The OneXPlayer X2 Mini Pro is one of the best spec sheets I've ever seen on a handheld PC, but in many ways it feels so jam-packed with features and power that it's not really useable as an actual handheld. 

More info: https://onexplayerstore.com/collections/gaming-consoles/products/onexplayer-x2-mini-pro-8-8-3-in-1-oled-gaming-handheld-with-amd-ryzen%E2%84%A2-ai-max-388-liquid-cooling

X2 Mini Pro impressions video: https://youtu.be/Fjv8xPLnWu4
OneXPlayer 3 review video: https://youtu.be/ErBcmwi7FXk

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
